title: Towards Faithful Simulation of Human Shopping Behavior
abstract: arXiv:2608.20707v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Simulating realistic user shopping behavior underpins offline evaluation and reinforcement learning in e-commerce scenarios. While recent LLM- and VLM-based simulators have made encouraging progress, reproducing a real browsing session remains difficult for two reasons. (i) Memory Challenge: a shopping session spans dozens of pages, yet existing agents either discard long-range observation histories, losing the evolving user state, or naively concatenate them, overwhelming the context window and even degrading simulation quality. (ii) Optimization Challenge: current user simulators are typically supervised to match each logged action via imitation or step-level rewards; the resulting sessions often display unrealistic patterns, such as over-exploration or excessive passivity, which per-step supervision can neither detect nor correct. translated_title: 迈向人类购物行为的忠实模拟
translated_abstract: 模拟逼真的用户购物行为是电子商务场景中离线评估和强化学习的基础。尽管基于LLM和VLM的最新模拟器取得了令人鼓舞的进展，但重现真实浏览会话仍然存在两大困难。(i) 记忆挑战：一个购物会话跨越数十个页面，但现有代理要么丢弃长期观察历史，导致用户状态演化丢失，要么简单拼接历史，使上下文窗口过载，甚至降低模拟质量。(ii) 优化挑战：当前用户模拟器通常通过模仿或步骤级奖励来监督每个记录动作；生成的会话常表现出不真实模式，如过度探索或过度被动，而逐步监督无法检测或纠正这些问题。为应对上述挑战，我们提出了RecVerse，一个基于GUI的模拟代理，它感知页面...
tldr: RecVerse通过GUI感知和创新的记忆与优化机制，解决了购物模拟中的长期记忆丢失和步骤级监督不足问题，实现了更忠实的用户行为模拟。
en_tdlr: RecVerse addresses memory and optimization challenges in shopping simulation via GUI-grounded perception and novel mechanisms, enabling more faithful user behavior modeling.
